verdict.rationale: Okta documents Cross App Access (XAA), an OIDC-based mechanism for building secure agent-to-app connections. That is the product's own capability for granting agents access without exposing user credentials. The pack does not show that these credentials can be scoped or restricted to least privilege. missing for 10: documentation of per-agent scope or permission restriction, explicit least-privilege token issuance and revocation, details of the credential lifecycle, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
